workContext.summary: Working on industrial automation projects, specifically developing control logic for automated machinery using Structured Text (ST) for PLCs. Current focus includes building a function block for a cotton candy machine with sugar level and motor speed control.

topOfMind.summary: Primary focus is on implementing a PLC function block in Structured Text (ST) for an automated cotton candy machine, which requires logic to control sugar feeding based on a 10.0-unit sugar level threshold and adjust motor speed to positive input values or 0 for non-positive inputs. Exploring proper implementation of PLC input/output variables and conditional logic in ST. Seeking efficient, compliant control logic for industrial machinery automation. Looking to ensure the function block meets specified operational requirements for sugar feeder activation and motor speed regulation. May be investigating other PLC control applications for automated equipment in parallel.

recentMonths.summary: Recently engaged in developing PLC control logic using Structured Text (ST), with a specific project focused on creating a function block for an automated cotton candy machine. This work involves defining input variables (SugarLevel as REAL, SpinningSpeed as INT) and output variables (SugarFeeder as BOOL, MotorSpeed as INT), and implementing conditional logic to manage sugar feeding and motor speed. Demonstrated interest in industrial automation control systems and precise, rule-based machinery operation.

facts.content: Requires PLC function blocks written in Structured Text (ST) for industrial automation projects
Working on an automated cotton candy machine control system that requires sugar feeding activation when SugarLevel (REAL) is below 10.0 units, deactivation at or above 10.0 units
Requires motor speed logic where MotorSpeed (INT) is set to the positive SpinningSpeed (INT) input, or 0 if SpinningSpeed is 0 or negative
Understands and uses PLC input/output variable types including REAL, INT, and BOOL for machinery control
